entries.text:
Sec. 19006.  (a) Waiver.--Section 3210(a)(6)(D) of title 39, United 
States Code, is amended by striking the period at the end of the first 
sentence and inserting the following: ``, and in

[[Page 134 STAT. 579]]

the case of the Commission, to waive this paragraph in the case of 
mailings sent in response to or to address threats to life safety.''.
    (b) Effective Date.--The amendments 
made by this subsection shall apply with respect to mailings sent on or 
after the date of the enactment of this Act.
